ground_truth_protocol.description: Modbus TCP ground truth derived from the evaluated capture (veth3614724-2.pcap, 200K messages) and validated against the Wireshark/tshark Modbus dissector (TShark 4.6.5). Every message on the wire is a 7-byte MBAP header followed by a Modbus PDU. Only the function codes actually present in the capture are modelled: FC01 Read Coils, FC02 Read Discrete Inputs, FC03 Read Holding Registers, FC04 Read Input Registers, FC05 Write Single Coil, FC06 Write Single Register. No exception responses or FC15/FC16 occur in this capture, so they are intentionally omitted. Expanded to the full Modbus function-code set; the evaluator scopes types to the function codes actually present in each capture, so a capture exercising only a subset is not penalised for the unused types.
ground_truth_protocol.offset_convention: MBAP header fields use wire-absolute offsets (0..6). All other (PDU) message types use PDU-relative offsets, i.e. offset 0 = function code = wire offset 7. This matches the evaluator, which treats header-role types as absolute and shifts PDU-type predictions left by the detected body offset before comparison.

message_types.name: Modbus TCP MBAP Header
message_types.description: Modbus TCP framing header prepended to every request and response PDU. Offsets are wire-absolute.

fields.name: transaction_identifier
fields.description: Echoed between a request and its response; used to match the two.

fields.name: length
fields.description: Number of following bytes (unit identifier + PDU).

fields.name: unit_identifier
fields.description: Remote slave / unit id (0x01 throughout this capture).

message_types.name: Read Coils Request
message_types.description: Reads the status of contiguous coils. PDU-relative offsets (function code at 0).

message_types.name: Read Coils Response
message_types.description: Returns packed coil status bytes. PDU-relative offsets.

fields.name: byte_count
fields.description: Number of coil status bytes that follow.

fields.name: coil_status
fields.description: Packed coil bits, least-significant bit first.

message_types.name: Read Discrete Inputs Request
message_types.description: Reads the status of contiguous discrete inputs. PDU-relative offsets.

fields.name: quantity_of_inputs
fields.description: Number of discrete inputs to read.

message_types.name: Read Discrete Inputs Response
message_types.description: Returns packed discrete input status bytes. PDU-relative offsets.

fields.name: byte_count
fields.description: Number of input status bytes that follow.

fields.name: input_status
fields.description: Packed discrete input bits, least-significant bit first.

message_types.name: Read Holding Registers Request
message_types.description: Reads contiguous holding registers. PDU-relative offsets.

message_types.name: Read Holding Registers Response
message_types.description: Returns holding register values. PDU-relative offsets.

fields.name: byte_count
fields.description: Number of register data bytes that follow (2 per register).

message_types.name: Read Input Registers Request
message_types.description: Reads contiguous input registers. PDU-relative offsets.

fields.name: quantity_of_registers
fields.description: Number of input registers to read.

message_types.name: Read Input Registers Response
message_types.description: Returns input register values. PDU-relative offsets.

fields.name: byte_count
fields.description: Number of register data bytes that follow (2 per register).

message_types.name: Write Single Coil
message_types.description: Writes a single coil ON (0xFF00) or OFF (0x0000). The response is a byte-identical echo of the request, so it forms a single message family. PDU-relative offsets.

message_types.name: Write Single Register
message_types.description: Writes a single holding register. The response is a byte-identical echo of the request, so it forms a single message family. PDU-relative offsets.

message_types.name: Write Single Coil Response
message_types.description: Byte-identical echo of the Write Single Coil request. Only in scope when the capture exposes a distinct response-direction family for FC 0x05 (i.e. request/response were separated by direction); a direction-blind capture keeps FC 0x05 as the single request-role echo type. PDU-relative offsets.

message_types.name: Write Single Register Response
message_types.description: Byte-identical echo of the Write Single Register request. Only in scope when the capture exposes a distinct response-direction family for FC 0x06; a direction-blind capture keeps FC 0x06 as the single request-role echo type. PDU-relative offsets.

message_types.name: Diagnostics Request
message_types.description: Serial-line diagnostics. PDU-relative offsets.

message_types.name: Diagnostics Response
message_types.description: Diagnostics echo response. PDU-relative offsets.

message_types.name: Write Multiple Coils Request
message_types.description: Writes a block of contiguous coils. PDU-relative offsets.

fields.name: byte_count
fields.description: Number of coil-value bytes that follow.

message_types.name: Write Multiple Coils Response
message_types.description: Acknowledges a Write Multiple Coils request. PDU-relative offsets.

message_types.name: Write Multiple Registers Request
message_types.description: Writes a block of contiguous holding registers. PDU-relative offsets.

fields.name: byte_count
fields.description: Number of register-value bytes that follow.

fields.name: register_values
fields.description: Register values to write (big-endian uint16 each).

message_types.name: Write Multiple Registers Response
message_types.description: Acknowledges a Write Multiple Registers request. PDU-relative offsets.

message_types.name: Report Server ID Request
message_types.description: Requests the server identification. PDU-relative offsets.

message_types.name: Report Server ID Response
message_types.description: Returns server identification data. PDU-relative offsets.

fields.name: server_id_data
fields.description: Server id, run indicator and vendor data.

message_types.name: Read/Write Multiple Registers Request
message_types.description: Combined read and write of register blocks in one transaction. PDU-relative offsets.

fields.name: read_starting_address
fields.description: Address of first register to read.

fields.name: write_starting_address
fields.description: Address of first register to write.

fields.name: write_byte_count
fields.description: Number of write-value bytes that follow.

message_types.name: Read/Write Multiple Registers Response
message_types.description: Returns the registers read by a Read/Write Multiple Registers request. PDU-relative offsets.

fields.name: byte_count
fields.description: Number of read-value bytes that follow.

message_types.name: Encapsulated Interface Transport Request
message_types.description: Encapsulated Interface Transport, Read Device Identification request. PDU-relative offsets.

fields.name: object_id
fields.description: Object id to start reading from.

message_types.name: Encapsulated Interface Transport Response
message_types.description: Encapsulated Interface Transport, Read Device Identification response. PDU-relative offsets.

fields.name: next_object_id
fields.description: Object id for the next request when more follows.

fields.name: number_of_objects
fields.description: Number of objects in this response.

fields.name: object_list
fields.description: Sequence of (object id, length, value) records.

relations.description: Read Coils request is answered by a Read Coils response with the same transaction identifier.
Read Discrete Inputs request is answered by a Read Discrete Inputs response with the same transaction identifier.
Read Holding Registers request is answered by a Read Holding Registers response with the same transaction identifier.
Read Input Registers request is answered by a Read Input Registers response with the same transaction identifier.
Write Single Coil response is a byte-identical echo of the request (same family); paired by transaction identifier.
Write Single Register response is a byte-identical echo of the request (same family); paired by transaction identifier.
Diagnostics request is echoed by a Diagnostics response with the same transaction identifier.
Write Multiple Coils request is acknowledged by a response with the same transaction identifier.
Write Multiple Registers request is acknowledged by a response with the same transaction identifier.
Report Server ID request is answered by a response with the same transaction identifier.
Read/Write Multiple Registers request is answered by a response with the same transaction identifier.
Encapsulated Interface Transport request is answered by a response with the same transaction identifier.
A function 0x01 request may be answered by an exception response (function 0x81) with the same transaction identifier.
A function 0x02 request may be answered by an exception response (function 0x82) with the same transaction identifier.
A function 0x03 request may be answered by an exception response (function 0x83) with the same transaction identifier.
A function 0x04 request may be answered by an exception response (function 0x84) with the same transaction identifier.
A function 0x05 request may be answered by an exception response (function 0x85) with the same transaction identifier.
A function 0x06 request may be answered by an exception response (function 0x86) with the same transaction identifier.
A function 0x08 request may be answered by an exception response (function 0x88) with the same transaction identifier.
A function 0x0F request may be answered by an exception response (function 0x8F) with the same transaction identifier.
A function 0x11 request may be answered by an exception response (function 0x91) with the same transaction identifier.
A function 0x17 request may be answered by an exception response (function 0x97) with the same transaction identifier.
A function 0x2B request may be answered by an exception response (function 0xAB) with the same transaction identifier.
